# Ryan Morris Comedy

> Niagara-based stand-up comedian documenting live sets across Southern Ontario. Brand: COMEDY.EXE.

Ryan Morris performs observational, self-aware stand-up with crowd work, act-outs, and experimental open-mic bits. He tracks every set, records everything, and treats comedy like a craft. By day he works in tech (systems / data); by night he ships sets. Dual identity: comedian + developer at github.com/hackmods. Based in the Niagara Region (Niagara Falls / St. Catharines), performing venues including Laugh Lab / Bomb Comedy Tour, Spotlight Comedy Club, Local Laughs, Failed To Render, and Rose City Comedy Collective.
